brief:
Spare parts shortages in Gaza have left thousands of people with disabilities immobilized, Shehab Wire reported. Disabled residents depend on wheelchairs to move but face a critical shortage of replacement parts, forcing many into forced isolation as the conflict continues. Temporary solutions have proven inadequate to address the scale of need.

The lack of functional mobility devices compounds existing hardship for people with disabilities already struggling to access basic services. Without working wheelchairs, many are confined to their homes, unable to reach medical care, water distribution points, or other essential facilities amid ongoing fighting.

title: Broken wheelchairs isolate disabled Palestinians in Gaza
